# CEUR-WS.org

> > CEUR-WS.org is an open-access digital library for publishing peer-reviewed workshop proceedings across computer science, artificial intelligence, and related fields.

CEUR-WS.org (Central Europe Research Workshop Series) is a long-established publication service hosted at RWTH Aachen University and archived by TIB Hannover, providing free and open access to academic workshop proceedings under Creative Commons licensing. The platform serves as a trusted venue for disseminating research from specialized workshops, doctoral symposia, and domain-specific series like AIxIA and IAOA.

## Getting Started & Publishing Guide

- [Publishing at CEUR-WS.org](https://ceur-ws.org/HOWTOSUBMIT.html): Guide for publishing workshop proceedings at CEUR-WS.org with author guidelines
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-XXX - Workshop on Publishing Papers with CEUR-WS YYYY](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-XXX): HTML template and submission instructions for CEUR-WS workshop proceedings
- [CEUR-WS Tools for Workshop Organizers](https://ceur-ws.org/ceurtools): Tools and scripts for workshop organizers to validate submissions and compliance

## Policies & Guidelines

- [CEUR-WS Core Values](https://ceur-ws.org/CEURWS-VALUES.html): CEUR-WS.org core values and principles for open-access academic publishing
- [CEUR-WS Policy on AI-Assisting Tools](https://ceur-ws.org/GenAI/Policy.html): CEUR-WS policy on generative AI use, disclosure, and responsible research ethics
- [CEUR-WS Policy on AI-Assisting Tools](https://ceur-ws.org/happypath.html): CEUR-WS policy and workflow guidance for AI-assisting tools in submissions

## Archive & Preservation

- [CEUR-WS.org: Long-term archival by TIB Hannover](https://ceur-ws.org/CEURWS-TiB.html): Long-term digital preservation of CEUR-WS proceedings by TIB Hannover
- [ISSN Entry for CEUR Workshop Proceedings](https://ceur-ws.org/issn-1613-0073.html): ISSN registry entry (1613-0073) for CEUR Workshop Proceedings publication

## Specialized Series

- [CEUR-WS.org - AIxIA Series](https://ceur-ws.org/aixia.html): CEUR-WS.org AIxIA Series for Italian AI Association workshop proceedings
- [CEUR-WS.org - IAOA Series](https://ceur-ws.org/iaoa.html): CEUR-WS.org IAOA Series for ontology and applications workshop proceedings

## Recent Workshop Proceedings

- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4185 - Latin American Women in Computing 2025](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4185): LAWCC 2025 workshop proceedings on women in computing in Latin America
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4183 - 1st Streaming Continual Learning Bridge at AAAI 2026](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4183): StreamingCL 2026 workshop proceedings on streaming continual learning
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4181 - Annual Doctoral Symposium of Computer Science 2025](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4181): Doctoral Symposium proceedings on computer science AI and cybersecurity topics
- [CEUR-WS.org/Vol-4179 - CRISTAIN 2025 Workshop Proceedings](https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4179): CRISTAIN 2025 workshop on crime resolution through artificial intelligence
